description: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE with a DOLLAR-QUOTED statement string. The form's value is that the inner SQL needs no quote escaping, so a CREATE TABLE, an INSERT carrying a quoted apostrophe, a SELECT, a CREATE VIEW, a CREATE PROCEDURE whose own body is single-quoted, a CREATE FUNCTION, a DELETE and an UPDATE all go through verbatim. The single-quoted form still works beside it, which is the mixed-styles regression guard. Each statement's EFFECT is checked, not merely that it parsed. Converted 1:1 from scripting/ExecuteImmediateDollarQuotedTest (now retired); the Java read the JDBC ResultSet row by row, and where it scanned SHOW TABLES / SHOW PROCEDURES / SHOW FUNCTIONS for a name that becomes a RESULT_SCAN over the same SHOW. Its INSERT test asserted only that the stored name CONTAINS 'Brien' because it was unsure whether the doubled quote survived; the converted step pins the whole value.

steps.sql: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, price INTEGER)$$
CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$INSERT INTO users VALUES (1, 'John O''Brien')$$
CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, salary INTEGER)
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$SELECT * FROM employees WHERE salary > 60000$$
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$CREATE PROCEDURE calculate_bonus(emp_salary INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'BEGIN RETURN emp_salary * 0.10; END'$$
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$CREATE TABLE inventory (id INTEGER, product_name VARCHAR, quantity INTEGER)$$
CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER, customer VARCHAR, amount INTEGER)
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$CREATE VIEW high_value_orders AS SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount > 100$$
SELECT id, customer, amount FROM high_value_orders ORDER BY id
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$CREATE FUNCTION triple(x INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'x * 3'$$
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" IN ('TEST1','TEST2')
CREATE TABLE items (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$DELETE FROM items WHERE id = 1$$
CREATE TABLE prices (id INTEGER, amount INTEGER)
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$UPDATE prices SET amount = 200 WHERE id = 1$$
